notes:
Pass on the fake backend (G1-G9; G6 and G8 warn only). The package is simulated R0 and model-authored: no hardware run and no PyBullet run were made, and no human reviewed or tested it. The fake is a pure Python stand-in for learning.yertle_env:YertleEnv's reset/step/close and Box spaces and returns the full 48-element observation. NOT COVERED: cap.world.render.v1 and the 640x480 RGB array of render() are not bound or modelled; PyBullet contact, friction, the position servo, the URDF inertia override and termination by falling are not modelled (terminated is always false; only the default episode length truncates); the fake uses Python random.Random while upstream uses numpy's default_rng, so a seed does not reproduce upstream; a YertleEnvConfig passed to the fake is ignored. No sim backend is declared: no gymnasium id is registered for YertleEnv in the clone and opening it would import the read-only clone, which package code must not do. The family warnings stay: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the pending seed of the next reset) and G8.NO_UNIT for the seed (twice), ticks and action.values inputs the bridge derives. The card's Isaac Lab mock hints name the external isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv, so the in-tree learning.yertle_env:YertleEnv is the native class. The 720-step truncation used by the tests is derived from the default 12 s / (1/240 s * 4) configuration and is test data, not a Fact or a Limit. Every Fact cites upstream_code at the pinned commit; no Limit is declared and no catalogue extension was used.
